Are you a hands-on procurement professional who thrives close to production?

Do you enjoy keeping things moving, following up, coordinating details, and ensuring materials are available where and when they are needed? We are looking for a Procurement Assistant to support daily procurement operations and act as a key operational link between Procurement and Production.

Your Role

You’ll work closely with Procurement, Planning, and Production, supporting day-to-day procurement execution and follow-up across assigned categories. The role is highly operational and execution-focused, with a strong emphasis on material availability, supplier follow-up, and stable production support.

You will support buyers and category managers with operational tasks, data handling, and coordination, playing a key role in maintaining smooth material flow and reliable deliveries.

Your tasks include:

• Executing daily procurement activities, including purchase orders, confirmations, and system updates

• Following up on supplier deliveries and production-critical materials

• Supporting material availability and shortage handling aligned with production plans

• Acting as an operational interface between Procurement and Production, providing status updates and visibility

• Maintaining accurate procurement data, documentation, and reporting in ERP systems

Short- and Long-Term Success

In the first 6–12 months, success means:

• Reliable and timely follow-up on purchase orders and supplier deliveries

• Accurate and up-to-date procurement data in ERP systems

• Strong day-to-day cooperation with Procurement, Planning, and Production

Longer term, you’ll take ownership of…

• Providing stable and predictable operational support to production

• Ensuring consistent supplier follow-up and execution quality

• Maintaining high data quality that supports planning and procurement decisions as operations scale

What You Bring

You’re an execution-focused and reliable team member who enjoys working close to production and material flow. You take responsibility for follow-up, coordination, and details—and you understand how your work directly impacts production stability and delivery performance.

You likely:

• Have experience from a procurement assistant, purchasing support, or similar operational role

• Are comfortable working close to production, logistics, or manufacturing environments

• Understand purchase order handling, delivery follow-up, and supplier interaction

• Are familiar with ERP systems and operational data handling

• Communicate clearly in English; Danish is preferred

Formal education is not a strict requirement. Hands-on experience is valued more highly.

Who You Are

You’re not just supporting procurement—you help keep production running. You enjoy being close to operations and take pride in following tasks through from start to finish.

You bring:

• Execution and reliability – you follow up, close loops, and ensure things get done

• Ownership – you take responsibility for operational tasks and escalate issues when needed

• Collaboration – you work closely with Procurement, Planning, Production, and suppliers

• Structure and attention to detail – you ensure accuracy in systems, documentation, and follow-up

• A hands-on mindset – you’re comfortable with routine tasks and understand their importance

You thrive in an engineering- and production-oriented environment with high accountability and a strong focus on delivery stability and continuous improvement.

Why Join Us?

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science, and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported, and inspired to push boundaries together.

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

• Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry

• Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us

• Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike

• Work across borders and build a strong international network

• Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

JOIN OUR MISSION

You are comfortable taking ownership of complex technical tasks and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are curious, motivated, and responsible, and you thrive in environments where software reliability and long‑term maintainability matter. You communicate fluently in both written and spoken English.

• Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related field.

Are you a strategic leader with deep expertise in offsets and defense procurement? Do you want to shape GomSpace’s role as a trusted partner for defense primes and governments worldwide?

As our Offset Business Development Director, you will take ownership of driving our growth in the offset segment by identifying, developing, and securing key opportunities and partnerships. You will build a global network of defense primes and governmental stakeholders, helping them meet their offset obligations using GomSpace’s portfolio of innovative products and solutions.

This is a role where strategic insight, relationship-building, and execution come together to create real impact in complex and dynamic markets.

Your Role and Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead, and coordinate business development activities related to offsets, acting as the go-to expert internally and externally. You will translate national offset policies and political objectives into actionable business strategies and drive collaboration across internal teams to align resources and priorities.

Your tasks will include:

• Leading the development and implementation of offset and industrial cooperation strategies that support long-term growth.

• Building and maintaining strong relationships with defense primes, governments, institutions, and political stakeholders in target markets.

• Translating national policies and political targets into meaningful offset projects that gain governmental traction.

• Developing and executing capture strategies for RFPs and offset financing aligned with GomSpace’s commercial goals.

• Collaborating closely with product, engineering, and business development teams to tailor offerings and create competitive advantage.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a results-oriented, strategic thinker who thrives in complex defense environments and can navigate diverse stakeholder landscapes with diplomacy and influence.

You will bring:

• Proven experience in defense or space business development, especially with offsets and government procurement processes.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with a strong customer and value proposition focus.

• An established network within defense primes and governmental organizations, ideally across multiple regions.

• Sufficient technical understanding to align customer needs with GomSpace’s portfolio of solutions.

• Fluency in English; additional language skills such as Spanish or Arabic are a strong advantage.

Are you ready to leverage your expertise to grow GomSpace’s business and strengthen our position as a partner of choice in the global defense ecosystem? We’d love to hear from you.

Why Join Us?

As Offset Business Development Director, you’ll not only grow our business – you’ll shape the way GomSpace engages with the world’s most strategic players. You’ll operate on a high-impact level, developing offset strategies that fuel technological advancement and build sovereign capabilities across key markets.

We offer an international, mission-driven environment where innovation, purpose, and execution go hand in hand. You’ll collaborate with experts across the company – from BD and engineering to solutions and strategy – to create offset offerings that deliver real, measurable impact.

If you're ready to turn complex regulations into strategic growth and build alliances that stretch across sectors and borders, we’d love to hear from you.

*This role is based out of our Copenhagen HQ office and requires native French, with strong English skills*

As an Account Executive for the French Mid-Market, you’ll join our team at the heart of the action, right on our home turf in Copenhagen. You'll be literally at the centre of where the fun happens, with a unique opportunity to drive change and see the direct impact of your work on our business growth.

You’ll be responsible for winning new mid-market customers in France and managing the full sales cycle, from identifying and prospecting potential customers through to discovery, demonstration, negotiation and closing. You will join our French Mid-Market team, working closely with both Account Executives and Account Managers.

This is an outbound-led role. You will be expected to generate a substantial share of your own pipeline through consistent and targeted outreach. Your prospecting efforts will be complemented by meetings generated by our BDR team and qualified inbound leads.

You’ll engage with senior decision-makers, uncover complex business needs and build compelling business cases that demonstrate the commercial value of Trustpilot. We’re not just selling SaaS. You’ll help established French businesses use trust and transparency to strengthen their brands, improve customer acquisition and accelerate growth.

What you’ll be doing:

• Drive new business across the French Mid-Market, from prospecting to close.

• Own and exceed a monthly revenue target through consistent pipeline creation and strong deal execution.

• Generate a substantial share of your pipeline through proactive and personalised outbound prospecting across phone, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

• Manage opportunities created through your own outreach, BDR-booked meetings and qualified inbound leads.

• Identify and engage key decision-makers, including C-level stakeholders, across multiple industries.

• Run structured discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s priorities, challenges, commercial objectives and decision-making process.

• Build compelling business cases and deliver tailored product demonstrations that clearly connect Trustpilot’s solutions to the prospect’s needs.

• Navigate more complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders, commercial negotiations and higher-value solutions.

• Use your initiative and commercial judgement to prioritise opportunities and manage your sales funnel effectively.

• Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce.

• Develop your capabilities for continued growth within Mid-Market and Enterprise SaaS sales.

Who you are:

• Fluent in French, with strong English skills.

• 3 years of experienced in full-cycle B2B sales, including outbound prospecting, qualification, discovery, demonstration, negotiation and closing.

• Proven track record in SaaS or Tech sales, with consistent quota achievement.

• Comfortable generating your own opportunities and maintaining a high level of outbound activity.

• Experienced in selling higher-value solutions to mid-market businesses and managing several stakeholders throughout the sales process.

• Confident in engaging with senior and C-level decision-makers and adapting your approach to the French business environment.

• Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into clear commercial value.

• Able to manage a varied pipeline while prioritising the opportunities most likely to progress and close.

• Competitive, resilient and motivated by achieving and exceeding targets.

• A proactive self-starter with the ambition to grow a career in Mid-Market and Enterprise SaaS sales.

• Knowledge of e-commerce, digital marketing or online reputation management is a plus.

What's in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

The Opportunity

Join Clobotics as a Sparrow Robot Operator and take part in robotic wind turbine blade repair operations at onshore and offshore locations worldwide. This hands-on role combines robotics, field operations, technical maintenance, and close coordination with wind industry teams.

The position is based in Esbjerg, Denmark.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct safe and efficient Sparrow robotic repair operations on wind turbines in accordance with regulatory requirements, company policies, and industry best practices.

• Remain calm under pressure, communicate clearly with team members, and follow operational checklists diligently.

• Perform regular maintenance checks, calibrations, and equipment troubleshooting to maintain system functionality and minimize downtime.

• Follow Clobotics safety protocols and risk-assessment procedures to mitigate potential hazards and maintain a safe working environment.

• Collaborate closely with vessel crews, client technicians, and control-room teams to support clear communication and effective use of working time.

• Maintain accurate records of daily progress and other required operational documentation.

• Keep up with industry best practices and emerging trends, pursuing opportunities for training and professional development.

Qualifications & Experience

• Relevant occupational certificates and training in line with our Occupational Training Matrix, along with any required client- or turbine-specific certifications.

• Clear written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Experience working offshore on crew transfer vessels or other support vessels, with technical or process equipment, or at onshore or offshore wind park sites is preferred.

• Good physical fitness for physically demanding work, a strong commitment to safety, and excellent attention to detail.

• Strong problem-solving skills, sound technical competence, and the ability to thrive as part of a team.

What We Offer

• A global working environment at a leading company in the automation and digitalization of wind turbine blade maintenance.

• Supportive colleagues, room for personal development, and a relaxed atmosphere with a winning mentality.

• A unique opportunity to work with advanced robotic technology in a growing company.

• Professional development and further training within the wind turbine service and robotics sector.

About Clobotics Wind Services

Clobotics is a global market leader in onshore and offshore wind turbine blade maintenance. We provide wind turbine operators and manufacturers with a full-scope service offering based on groundbreaking technology developed in-house, including robotics, autonomous drones, cloud processing, web portals, apps, and material technology.

Our EMEA operation is based in Esbjerg, Denmark, with sister companies in Seattle, Shanghai, and Singapore. The Danish team manages EMEA operations and develops projects designed for the European market.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Genmab is seeking an experienced Senior Clinical Drug Supply Manager to join our Global Clinical Drug Supply in Copenhagen. The role requires candidates to be within commuting distance of our office locations to work according to our hybrid work arrangement. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage trials.

As a Senior Manager, Global Clinical Drug Supply, you will play a pivot role supporting the development and execution of clinical drug demand forecasts and supply plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery of clinical development products across Genmab’s pipeline. Your responsibilities will include managing the demand planning and supply planning of clinical supplies. This role will partner closely with cross-functional clinical development and CMC teams to maintain accurate forecasts, support supply strategy execution, and contribute to the operational success of clinical programs. The Senior Manager will apply strong analytical, communication, and planning skills to ensure reliable clinical supply while contributing to continuous process improvement across GCDS.

As a Senior Clinical Drug Supply Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring efficient delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage Genmab clinical trials worldwide.

The ideal candidate possesses an understanding of cGMP and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality work, demonstrating a proactive approach and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure the best outcome for patients.

This position is hybrid and requires you to be in the office 60% of the time.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning & Forecasting

• Support the development, maintenance, and updates of clinical drug demand forecasts across assigned studies and programs.

• Collaborate with, CTT, and Finance to collect inputs and ensure forecasts reflect current enrollment trends, protocol changes, and assumptions.

• Manage the demand planning discussions as part of the Clinical Project Supply Team (CPST) and support forecasting activities within the CSIOP process.

• Identify potential demand risks and escalate issues in a timely manner, recommending mitigation actions where appropriate.

• Prepare demand plan summaries, enrollment updates, and cost forecasts to support program planning and operational reviews.

Supply Strategy & Execution

• Coordinate clinical supply–related planning activities, ensuring alignment between forecasted needs, study timelines, and supply availability.

• Support the execution of clinical supply chain sourcing strategies using third-party providers, in collaboration with Clinical Operations and Supply Leads.

• Contribute to communication of GCDS Planning Strategy within Global Clinical Teams, ensuring supply planning assumptions are clearly understood.

• Track supply readiness and highlight risks or gaps that could affect clinical trial continuity.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management

• Support Supplier Relationship Management activities by tracking supplier performance metrics and helping identify improvement opportunities.

• Build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional partners (Clinical Operations, CTT, CDM, Regulatory, CMC, QA, and Finance) to enable timely and accurate supply planning.

Budget & Cost Optimization

• Support budget development activities by preparing supply planning inputs and cost forecasts aligned with program needs.

• Monitor budget performance and identify variances, working with senior team members to implement cost-effective solutions.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

• Provide planning updates and forecasting insights to support governance forums (IRC, CTT, Asset Meetings).

• Ensure consistent use of supply chain processes, tools, and systems by adhering to established standards and contributing feedback for enhancements.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on advancing forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and collaboration across GCDS.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

• Ensure demand planning and supply–related activities comply with GxP, regulatory standards, and Genmab quality expectations.

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation for demand forecasts, planning assumptions, and supply updates.

• Support identification and resolution of compliance gaps and contribute to corrective and preventive actions as needed

• Adhere to the Genmab Quality Management System

Qualifications

•    Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Supply Chain Management).

•    Minimum 8+ years of experience in clinical drug supply forecasting, supply planning, and demand planning

•    Demonstrated stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.

•    Experience working with vendors and CMOs for clinical trial supplies will be an advantage.

•    Solid knowledge of GDP and GMP. Knowledge of GCP will be an advantage.

•    Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

•    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

•    Highly organized with a structured, process-oriented mindset that supports continuous improvement.

•    Ability to prioritize effectively while maintaining a high level of quality and compliance.

•    Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work both independently and within global teams.

•    Results-driven and goal-oriented, committed to contributing to Genmab’s success.

The Team

You will join a highly competent team focused on demand planning and supply planning on clinical supplies, collaborating closely with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Execution team. Together with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Systems team and Global Clinical Drug Supply Manufacturing team, these four functions form the Global Clinical Drug Supply department. We foster a supportive, international, and fast-paced work environment centered on collaboration, excellence, and a can-do attitude to achieve results.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK687.888,00---1.031.832,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results.

Eligibility:

Educational requirements

a. Be enrolled in a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) and have completed one full academic year;

b. Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as master’s programme or higher);

c. Have recently graduated with a university degree as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation; or

d. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional trainee programme and undertake the internship as part of this programme.

Other eligibility requirements

e. Demonstrate interest in the field of development;

f.  Demonstrate written and spoken proficiency in at least one of the working languages of the United Nations (English or French) and fluency in the official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish) of the UNFPA office; and

g. Demonstrate ability to adapt to new environments and to establish and maintain good working relations with individuals of different cultural backgrounds.

An individual whose father, mother, son, daughter, brother or sister is a UNFPA staff member is not eligible for an internship with UNFPA.

Required Competencies:

Values:

• Exemplifying integrity,

• Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,

• Embracing cultural diversity,

• Embracing change

Core Competencies:

• Achieving results,

• Being accountable,

• Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,

• Thinking analytically and strategically,

• Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Financial Support:

Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses. The stipend is based on the intern’s agreed place of work, which may be different from the duty station of the hiring office in cases of remote arrangements. The stipend is normally paid in local currency at the end of each month.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.
